SEE YOUR FINANCIAL FUTURE (Unique Feature!)

• See how recurring bills and income will affect your finances months ahead

• Adjust your spending today to meet future financial goals

TRACK EVERYTHING
• Log income, expenses, and transfers across multiple accounts
• Organize transactions with customizable categories
• Set up recurring transactions for bills and subscriptions
• See your projected balance for any future date (unique forward-looking feature!)
• Search and filter transactions instantly

BUDGET LIKE A PRO
• Create monthly budgets by category
• Track spending vs. budget with visual progress bars
• Get alerts when you're approaching your limits
• Compare actual spending to your plan
• Copy budgets month-to-month effortlessly

ACHIEVE YOUR GOALS
• Set savings goals with target amounts and dates
• Track progress with beautiful visualizations
• Add funds to goals and watch your progress grow
• Celebrate when you reach your targets

POWERFUL ANALYTICS
• Year-to-date summary of income, expenses, and savings
• Income vs. Expenses charts by month
• Expenses breakdown by category (pie charts)
• Balance trend over time
• Filter analytics by account or combine them all

AI-POWERED ADVICE (Pro Feature)
• Get personalized financial recommendations
• Budgeting tips tailored to your spending
• Savings strategies based on your goals
• Debt management guidance
• Requires your own API key for maximum privacy and control

PRIVACY FIRST

• No account required - no sign up

• Export your data anytime (CSV)

• Dark and Light mode support

• Smooth animations

• Support for multiple currencies

record.name: Aligned: AI Coach & Planner
record.offering: Health & Fitness app; seller description requires review
record.description_evidence:
Whatever's on your mind — the house, the week, the thing you've been avoiding — just ask your coach. Sometimes you'll get a plan. Sometimes one small thing. Sometimes just company.

WHAT PEOPLE ASK

"Here's a photo of my pantry. I don't know where to start."
The shelves are fine — it's the floor that's become the overflow. Start there, twenty minutes, nothing else.

"I keep ordering in because I never know what to eat."
Pick three proteins and one theme. One shop on Monday, cook twice, eat all week.

"Company's coming and I've got two days."
Only the rooms they'll actually see. Bathroom Tuesday evening, kitchen and living room Wednesday, thirty-five minutes each.

"I forget my lunch every single morning."
Added to your 6:45 list, with a nudge the night before.

"I've drifted from a friend and I don't know how to text them first."
Let's write it together. Short, no apology for the gap.

"Honestly, I'm just done today."
Then nothing today. Want to talk it through, or should I move tomorrow back a day?

Home, work, family, health, the stuff in between. Your coach will break down what feels too big, tell you where to start, remind you at the right time, keep track of what you're working toward — and listen when that's all you want.

Pick the voice that suits you — calmer or more direct, practical or encouraging. Whoever you choose shows up the same way every day.

Aligned is not a medical service and does not provide diagnosis or treatment.

record.description_evidence:
Turn a pile of bank statements into a clear picture of your money. CashX reads statements from any bank, organizes every transaction, and gives you an AI copilot that actually understands your finances.

UPLOAD ANY STATEMENT
Add a PDF, CSV, or even a photo or screenshot of a statement from any bank. CashX's AI reads it, extracts every transaction, and cleans up messy descriptions automatically — works with Kaspi, Halyk, Freedom, and international banks alike.

ONE DASHBOARD FOR EVERY ACCOUNT
See all your banks and cards in a single unified view: balances, income vs. spending, and exactly where your money goes — automatically categorized, no manual entry.

YOUR PERSONAL FINANCE COPILOT
Ask anything: "Can I afford this?", "Where did my money go last month?", "How much am I spending on subscriptions?" The copilot answers using your real numbers — not generic advice.

AI FINANCIAL REVIEW
Get a personalized analysis of your cash flow, spending patterns, and concrete moves to improve this month — written around your actual data.

BUILT FOR EVERYONE
20 languages and multi-currency support, multi-bank from day one.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Your statements are encrypted and read-only. CashX never moves your money and never sells your data. You can delete everything, anytime, right from the app.

CashX is a personal-finance tool for education and insight — not a bank, broker, or licensed financial advisor.

SUBSCRIPTIONS
CashX Premium ($9.99/month) unlocks AI financial reviews, the copilot, and stock news. Payment is charged to your Apple ID account, and subscriptions auto-renew unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel anytime in your App Store account settings.

Are you a freelancer, gig worker, or small business owner drowning in paper receipts? Stop losing money. VaultTax is the only AI Receipt Scanner that processes everything on your device, ensuring your financial data never touches a third party server.

No cloud leaks. Just fast, accurate scanning.

WHY VAULTTAX IS DIFFERENT

100% Private and Offline Unlike other free scanners that upload your bank data to the cloud, VaultTax runs entirely on your iPhone using the advanced Apple Vision Framework. Your receipts, your data, your business. We cannot see your finances even if we wanted to.

AI That Actually Works Forget manual typing. Our Nano AI engine instantly extracts the Merchant Name, Transaction Date, Total Amount, Tax, and Category mapped to IRS Schedule C.

Maximize Your Tax Refund Every lost receipt is money donated to the IRS. VaultTax ensures you capture every deductible expense, from coffee meetings to gas mileage.

Smart Categorization automatically tags expenses as Meals, Travel, Supplies, or Advertising. Audit Proof Records stores a high resolution digital copy of every receipt alongside the data.

Accountant Ready Exports Dreading tax season? Generate professional reports in seconds.

PDF Reports create beautiful summary tables with attached receipt images. CSV and Excel options are compatible with TurboTax, QuickBooks, Xero, and Excel. AirDrop Ready allows you to send reports directly to your CPA or Mac without email.

DESIGNED FOR THE GIG ECONOMY

Perfect for Freelancers and 1099 Workers to keep personal and business expenses separate. Ideal for Uber and DoorDash Drivers to track gas and vehicle maintenance on the go. Great for Consultants to track billable expenses for client reimbursement. Essential for Contractors to log materials and supplies at the job site since it works offline.

KEY FEATURES AT A GLANCE

Instant Scan auto detects document edges and snaps the photo for you. Dark Mode Native is beautiful and saves battery. Search Anything to find that one Home Depot receipt from 6 months ago in milliseconds. No Accounts Required means no signup forms and no bank linking. Just download and scan.

Download VaultTax today and be ready for Tax Season 2026!

VaultTax is free to try for your first scan. Continued use requires a paid subscription. Available plans and their prices are shown in the app before you confirm any purchase.

Payment will be charged to your Apple ID account at confirmation of purchase. Your subscription automatically renews unless it is canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Your account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can manage or cancel your subscription in your Apple ID account settings at any time after purchase.

record.name: Productive AI Coach
record.offering: Productivity app; seller description requires review
record.description_evidence:
Talk to your AI life coach by voice - not typing. Set goals, build habits, and stay accountable with check-ins that remember what you committed to.

Productive AI Coach is voice-first coaching for busy people who want follow-through without another productivity system to manage.

HOW IT WORKS
1. Start a voice call and say what you’re working on
2. Get clear next steps, milestones, and habits
3. Check in again - your coach picks up where you left off

WHAT YOU GET
• Real voice conversations (not endless typing)
• Goals broken into milestones and daily actions
• Habit tracking with reminders that fit your day
• Five coaching styles - supportive to challenging - switch anytime
• Try free, then choose a plan in the app if you want more

BEST FOR
Busy professionals, founders, and anyone building consistency with goals and routines. Prefer talking over forms and streak trackers.

WHAT THIS IS NOT
Not therapy or clinical mental health care. Not a voice generator or text-to-speech toy. Not a generic chatbot - you get structure and accountability across sessions.

FAQ
Is it like ChatGPT? ChatGPT answers questions. This is built for coaching: voice calls, memory, goals, habits, and follow-up.
Do I need a human coach too? Many people use both - human sessions for deep work, AI for daily check-ins in between.
Is my data private? Your coaching conversations stay in your account. See our privacy policy for details.

Download and try a real voice session first. Plans are available in the app when you’re ready.

record.description_evidence:
Meatball is a planner-calendar-coach-alarm. It is the only AI assistant that can proactively ACTUALLY text and CALL YOU.  These are unmissable alerts - no more time missing things. 

Meatball turns your goals, routines and life goals into a to-do list in your calendar.  Then, it calls and texts you to helps you start, stay on track, and recover when things go wrong.

If something disrupts your routine, Meatball’s calls catch it and help you reschedule so you can keep moving forward—without starting over (ADHD friendly). 

Gamification keeps the habit alive. When you finish a task, you get points and streaks to motivate you.

**Habit tracker and long-term routines**
Meatball is perfect for multi-day progressive quests. 
Whether you’re training for a marathon, running recurring routines, or building discipline one day at a time,  we’ll
- create the full plan (e.g. the 3 month marathon plan)
- schedule each run for each day, based on the best time for that day
- create alerts and calls to remind you to leave.

 You’ll see what to do next, what to focus on now, and how your habits are compounding over time.  

**Neurodivergent approved BFF** 

Think of Meatball as your pocket best friend. We’re friendly, but we’ll still roast you to keep you motivated. 
Meatball uses energy based, neurodivergent friendly planning (ADHD/anxiety/depression) to help you plan your days. This is the perfect daily routine planner for self-care and motivation, or to chose your goals. 

**Use cases**

1. AI morning calls to wake you up and plan your day
- Get a clear daily schedule to follow
- Turn vague intentions into actionable steps

2. Personalised, better scheduling
- Flexible systems to fit any purpose in life
- AI “calendar coach” that adapts to you with:
    - Energy based scheduling
    - Realistic planning (predicted vs actual time)
- Perfect for context-switchers who need temporal boundaries, or neurodivergent people with time blindness
3. Self-care/ADHD/neurodivergent: Meatball breaks down tasks to avoid you feeling overwhelmed, and adapts your plan based on your energy.  
4. Chase big goals 
- We can help you set goals, that finally help you achieve your biggest dreams
- create the full plan (e.g. the 3 month marathon plan)
- schedule each run for each day, based on the best time for that day
- create alerts and calls to remind you to leave.


5. Proactive check-ins that help you stick to your plan
 
6. AI texts/calls to reschedule when things change
- When plans slip, Meatball helps you update your plan instead of abandoning it
- Keep your goals alive even during busy days

7. Habit building: Track new habits with clear goals and gentle accountability. 
8. Gamified habits, streaks, and points 
- Gain XP and points for finishing tasks
- Build streaks by completing routines across multiple days
- Levelling system and streaks make it a real life RPG
- Radar to track progress in each category in your life 

**Why Meatball feels different**
Most to-do apps don’t keep you accountable. Life gets busy, schedules shift, and plans quietly fall apart—until you feel behind. 
Meatball is not just a static calendar planner. It’s an AI friend that helps you follow through—by planning proactively, reminding you when it matters, and supporting you when your schedule shifts.

**Privacy-minded and practical**
Meatball is designed to support your productivity with helpful scheduling and reminders. Your experience is centered on keeping your daily schedule clear and actionable.

**Get started today**
If you want a daily planner that supports habits, focus, and accountability—try Meatball. Build streaks, plan recurring routines, and use AI to keep your day on track.

Silo lets you control what AI knows.

Your memory, your services, your context — in one place, working across every AI model. Silo is the only control layer between your data and the models that use it. Privacy is the foundation. Ownership is the product. Portability is the growth engine.

----

ONE MEMORY, EVERY MODEL

Most AI tools trap your history inside a single platform. Your ChatGPT conversations can't move to Claude. Your context resets every time you switch tools.

Silo fixes that. Your memory lives in your Silo — on your device, encrypted, portable. Switch between ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, and more without losing context. One subscription, every model. Nothing gets stuck.

----

A NEW KIND OF FILE

When we separated memory from AI models, we created something new: the .silo file. A portable, shareable, structured knowledge package that any AI can query.

Share a travel plan that adapts to whoever opens it. Build a company knowledge base grounded in your actual thinking. Package what you know and send it to a collaborator.

Authored, not interpreted. Interactive, not static. Yours to share.

----

PRIVATE WHEN IT MATTERS

Private Assist runs AI entirely on your device. No internet required. Start a conversation locally, or switch to it mid-conversation when something becomes sensitive.

Your data never has to leave your device. But when you choose to use cloud models, Silo always asks before sharing anything.

----

INTELLIGENCE ON YOUR SIDE

Silo governs every interaction between your data and AI:

· PII scrubbing before data reaches any model
· Audit trail of what was shared and when
· Instant access revocation
· You control your encryption keys

Every AI that wants your data asks Silo first. You set the policy.

----

CONNECT YOUR WORLD

Silo extends beyond memory. Connect services like Google, Dropbox, and Plaid to your Silo. Any AI you authorize can access them — governed, auditable, revocable. One dashboard, one policy layer, full control.

----

GETS BETTER OVER TIME

The more you use Silo, the more your context compounds. Memories connect across conversations. Responses become more personal. Your Silo becomes the most complete picture of what matters to you — owned by you, useful everywhere.

----

Control what AI knows. Own yourself.

Using the Dual Messenger App you can have multiple Messenger accounts in one device! Have that work phone you don’t want to carry around? Or have dual sim but can’t use the Messengers for that one? Don’t worry, Dual Messenger got you covered! Just Scan the QR or use Phone Number Login and You will love our Compact View, which makes Desktop Messenger perfectly usable on a iPhone device! Login once and use forever! 

*** STAY ONLINE MODE ***
You can stay always online at background using the Dual Messenger App always without an effort.

*** AI IMAGE REMAKER ***
You have that photo that you dreamed but it’s blurred? Or you have shaken your camera accidentally? Or your photo is too small and looses quality when growing larger? Here the AI Image Remake Feature you can get your photos enhanced and scaled up! With a few taps and 30 seconds at most, you will have your photo made perfect by the AI. You can save your Remade photo to your photos or share it with a temporary link!

*** SHARE PHOTOS, VIDEOS AND FILES WITH LINK ***
You just want to send your pic/vid to someone but it looses quality with standard chatting apps? Or you want to share a homework or a document with a group of people? As simple as possible, just tap select and select your pic/vid/file and upload, you will then get a link to your file and by sharing it you can let people access to your pic/vid in original quality or let everyone download the file you shared as long as you want. Any time you want to delete just go to your files and delete, your link will be revoked and your file will cleaned up instantly. You can also track how many people accessed to your link!

You can inject your javascript code in during several types of events supported with the advanced browser, just copy & paste your code and select your event (page load start-stop-error, browser-start-stop) or your custom style sheet to alter views. Using this feature you can customize almost anything on the website you are visiting, you can add custom functions and debug the website/your script or extract anything it is using. You can also customize your views and make anything look like how you like them with the style sheet injection. After you add it once, app will save it and automatically inject on further use until you clear it!


All features can be freely used initially. However some of the features of the Dual Messenger application will require premium subscription/purchase after some uses.

Tap your name.

TaxApp is an all-in-one tax preparation and business bookkeeping platform designed for freelancers, self-employed individuals, and small business owners. It combines AI-driven automation with professional-grade tools to make tax season stress-free year-round.

Tax Pro Marketplace — Connect with CPAs and enrolled agents for professional review and filing assistance
Financial Reports — P&L, balance sheet, Schedule C, cash flow, and multi-year comparisons
Personal Tax Center — W-2, 1099, deductions, credits, digital assets, and state filing support
Smart Tools — AI deduction finder, capital gains calculator, quarterly tax calculator, and more
Built for non-accountants. Trusted by tax professionals.

record.description_evidence:
Samreshuuu gives you AI coworkers you can hand real work to. They work inside your business services the way you do and come back with the finished result.

Built for businesses that operate in Russia. Samreshuuu connects to the services Russian companies run on (1C, Bitrix24, amoCRM, MoySklad, Wildberries, Ozon, Yandex Market, Russian banks and e-document operators), prepares documents in Russian formats and stores data on servers in Russia. The app itself is available in English and Russian.

Works where you work
Connect over OAuth or an API key in about five minutes, 100+ systems: 1C, MoySklad, amoCRM, Bitrix24, RetailCRM, Megaplan, Wildberries, Ozon, Yandex Market, Avito, banks, Diadoc, SBIS, Kontur, Yandex and Google services. The agent does more than read data: it creates deals in amoCRM, updates stock in MoySklad and answers marketplace reviews. Where a service has no API, it opens the web cabinet in a browser and does what you would do.

Plain-language tasks
Explain the job once, the way you would to a new hire, in the app, Telegram or MAX. The same conversation continues on your phone and your computer. The agent remembers your counterparties, suppliers, document templates, margin formulas and past decisions, and comes back only when it needs your approval.

Several agents at once
Set up an agent for one area and add another when the work grows: finance, marketplaces, purchasing. They run in parallel around the clock, each with its own access, and hand work to each other in a shared conversation.

Set it once
A task keeps running on a schedule or on an event in your systems: a sales summary from 1C at 9:00, a MoySklad report every Monday, accounts receivable follow-up. The agent flags anomalies, stock-out risks and overdue payments on its own.

What Samreshuuu does:
• Analytics on your own data: ABC analysis, period comparisons, marketplace summaries and charts in the chat
• Documents on Russian standard forms: contracts, quotes, invoices, acts and claims, checked against 1C
• Answers your team in Telegram and MAX while cabinet access stays with the owner
• Files when you need a file: XLSX, DOCX and PDF straight into the conversation
• Changes nothing without asking: invoices, mailings and repricing arrive as drafts first

Work you can hand off
• Sales summary: figures from 1C and your CRM every morning in Telegram
• Receivables: overdue invoices, reminders to debtors, claims on standard forms
• Documents: an invoice or a quote from a request, with company details and VAT checked
• Purchasing: demand from current stock and a draft order to the supplier
• Marketplaces: profit per SKU, reviews, shipments, fines and deductions

Security: servers in Russia, TLS 1.3 and AES-256, compliant with Russian personal data law 152-FZ. Not a ChatGPT wrapper: models run on our own servers, company data is not sent to OpenAI or Anthropic and is not used for training.

Privacy policy: https://samreshuuu.ru/privacy
Terms of Use (EULA): https://samreshuuu.com/terms
Support: support@samreshuuu.ru

record.description_evidence:
==Modern Interface== 

 We're propelling Triangulum AI into the future with a modern user interface. Access all the features you know and love, now in a faster, more intuitive flow. With enhanced responsiveness, navigating and managing your account base has never been easier. A new dark mode has also been introduced so you can customize the app's feel to your liking.  

  

==New Metrics Dashboard== 

 View account base statistics that give you the ability to view the health of your accounts, address issues faster, and support a great customer experience. Customize the home page to your liking by toggling on and off the features you want to see.  

  

==Easier Account Test Management== 

 Use our improved no action flow to place accounts on and off test. You can view and interact with active no actions for your account base right from the home page or place a no action right from the new account overview page.  

Active no actions now have a live countdown timer that is visible from the account overview page, with the ability to quickly extend the time or remove it if you no longer need it.  

Once the no action has expired, grab the zone test report for quick documentation of all the signals that came in while the account was on no action.   

  

==Nearby Accounts== 

 Enhanced location services now give you the ability to view all of your accounts on the new dashboard maps page. You can also navigate to them easily from the individual account page! 

  

==Enhanced Account Overview== 

Account information and updates are now just a tap away with our new Account Overview page. Everything you need to know about an account is all in one place. Edit zones, update contacts, manage panel information, and view account history in an easy-to-use flow.  

  

==Security is Standard== 

Enable biometrics right from the settings to make your sign-in experience seamless across the Triangulum AI suite. Multi-factor authentication is standard, so you can rest easy knowing your data is secure.
